summary: Frontend E2E of the new Inline Quick-Order UX (inline search + mini-cart drawer + wallet-aware buttons + guest funnel + VPS/hosting quick-add) against the live preview URL. Executed 11 scenarios at 1920x1080 and 1 at 390x844 (mobile). 11/11 passed; 1 scenario (dashboard AdminCard 'Smart Suggestion' add) was NON-EXERCISABLE in the current dashboard state (no suggestion cards rendered for the buyer account, so no `.add-to-cart` anchors present) — the AdminCard component source is wired correctly (wallet-aware label + navigates via useCartUI, no /cart jump), just not visible on the dashboard today. Highlights: (A) /dashboard InlineDomainSearch returns exact + suggestions inline (no navigation); labels flip between 'Buy now' and 'Pay with crypto' per TLD price vs $50 wallet. (B) Clicking any inline-search-add-* auto-opens mini-cart-drawer with correct subtotal ($39), mini-cart-wallet-balance ($50), enabled Pay-from-wallet and Pay-with-crypto. (C) nav-cart-button opens the same drawer from anywhere and its nav-cart-count badge is live. (D) mini-cart-full-cart-link navigates to /cart. (E) Shortfall (3x $39 = $117 vs $50): mini-cart-pay-button becomes disabled but preserves the correct '$117.00 from wallet' amount, mini-cart-shortfall hint renders with clear copy, mini-cart-pay-crypto-button stays enabled and opens WalletModal with topup-amount-input preset to $117 (ceiled to 117). (F) VPS: /vps → server-add-<plan> opens the configure modal, server-add-to-cart-confirm auto-opens the drawer with a mini-cart-item-vps-* line and does NOT navigate to /cart (still on /vps). (G) Guest funnel: on /domains logged-out, header nav-cart-button is visible; searching and clicking exact-match-add-button opens the drawer with NO wallet balance, shows mini-cart-guest-checkout, and clicking it routes to /checkout/account (sign-in step). nav-cart-count reflects the guest cart. (H) Mobile 390x844: drawer becomes a full-viewport sheet (0,0,390,844), no horizontal overflow, buttons and subtotal legible. No blocking bugs; the only non-blocking item is that the WalletModal supported-currencies call is still slow in this preview env (previously flagged in iteration_3) — the modal itself opens preset correctly. Buyer wallet was NOT spent in this run (no wallet-pay executed).

issues: Drawer covers the full viewport (100vw x 100vh). That's fine but the top-right close 'X' (mini-cart-close) is a bit small (~24px tap target); consider bumping to 40x40 for iOS thumb-friendliness.

action_items: OPTIONAL: dashboard AdminCard 'Smart Suggestion' add-to-cart flow could not be exercised because no suggestion cards render for the current buyer state — main agent to confirm which state/data triggers those cards (or seed one) if you want it explicitly verified. The code path itself looks correct in adminCard.jsx (wallet-aware label + useCartUI open on click).

Investigate GET /api/v1/wallet/supported-currencies latency in the preview env (carried over from iteration_3) — the WalletModal 'Get address' remains hard to exercise end-to-end due to 'Loading coins…' hang.
critical_code_review_comments: MiniCartDrawer subtotal fallback: when quote is pending, `subtotal = quote?.subtotal_usd ?? cart.subtotal`. If a stale quote from a previous cart is still in state when the cart changes, the drawer briefly shows the OLD subtotal + 'Updating prices…' on the button. Consider resetting `quote` to null on cart-count/id-set change so the fallback surfaces the fresh local subtotal immediately (minor UX polish).

MiniCartDrawer 'Pay $X with crypto' button label: in shortfall mode the label shows the FULL payable (e.g. $117), but the WalletModal opens preset to ONLY the shortfall in the ceiled amount. Same comment as iteration_3 — consider labelling the button 'Top up $X with crypto' in shortfall mode so users understand the modal amount matches the shortfall, not the full order.

InlineDomainSearch results: 7 add-buttons rendered for one search but two of them shared the same data-testid `inline-search-add-<exact.com>` (exact card + first row). Duplicate data-testids break unique-selector automation. Suggest suffixing one, e.g. `inline-search-add-<domain>-row` for the list vs `inline-search-add-<domain>-exact` for the exact card, OR ensuring the exact-match card is the sole owner of `inline-search-add-<exact.com>`.

AdminCard uses <a href='#' onClick=…> for the Buy-now/Pay-with-crypto CTA. `href='#'` scrolls to top on some browsers if the handler doesn't preventDefault. Prefer a <button> or ensure e.preventDefault() in handleBuyNow. Also add data-testid (e.g., `admin-card-buy-<slug>`) for automated verification.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of exercisable scenarios (11/11); 1 scenario skipped due to missing UI state (no smart-suggestion cards on current dashboard)

test_credentials: buyer@nameword.local / Buyer@12345 — wallet was $50.00 at start AND at end of this run (no wallet order placed).
seed_data_creation: Client-side only: localStorage `nw_cart_v2` seeded with 3x $39 domain items for the shortfall scenario, then cleared. No server writes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new test-ids validated live: inline-search-input, inline-search-submit, inline-search-exact, inline-search-suggestions, inline-search-add-<domain>, mini-cart-drawer, mini-cart-close, mini-cart-subtotal, mini-cart-wallet-balance, mini-cart-pay-button, mini-cart-pay-crypto-button, mini-cart-shortfall, mini-cart-full-cart-link, mini-cart-guest-checkout, mini-cart-item-vps-*, nav-cart-button, nav-cart-count. cartStore item shape MUST include `price_usd` (NOT `price`) and `ns_choice`/`nameservers` for domains, otherwise quote returns $0 and shortfall path won't trigger. VPS flow: click `server-add-<plan>` first to open the configure modal, then `server-add-to-cart-confirm` — the drawer auto-opens after confirm. On /hosting, click a 'Select plan' button to open the configure modal (`Add to cart · $X` inside). Public /domains uses its own `domain-search-input` + `domain-search-button` + `exact-match-add-button` / `option-add-<domain>` (NOT InlineDomainSearch) — guest flow validated there. WalletModal preset uses Math.ceil (matches iteration_3 note). Buyer wallet is intact ($50) — no re-seed needed unless you place a real wallet-pay order.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues. The one non-exercised scenario (AdminCard 'Smart Suggestion' buy) is a data/state visibility gap, not a code defect — the AdminCard component and its useCartUI open-on-add wiring are present and correct in the source (adminCard.jsx lines 101-107, wallet-aware label at line 104-106).
